hypothesis: Before any further selector/adaptive-mixture tuning, directly test whether frozen C0 and N1 components are adequate for their intended W0 and W2 synthetic oracle components on two preregistered disjoint seeds.
input_dataset: Digital Twin v1 synthetic only; seeds 20260920 and 20260921, 500 standard 7-rider races per seed. No real/historical input.
conclusion: C0 is consistently the appropriate W0 reference, while N1 is only marginally better than the best PL baseline on W2 and misses the preregistered >=5% overall improvement gate on both seeds. The prior adaptive-selector failure is therefore primarily component-limited rather than a reason to tune the selector further.
scientific_implication: Build a separately preregistered PRE-only synthetic conditional component whose coefficients are aligned to the explicit W2 simulator specification without latent-skill access, then validate it on disjoint synthetic seeds before revisiting adaptive mixtures. Do not alter N1 in place or weaken v5 gates.
follow_up: Preregister and execute a synthetic spec-aligned conditional component validation using PRE only; keep all real/economics scopes closed.
